snippet.title: Blood in the Panopticon — Official Launch Trailer | ASCII Action Roguelike
snippet.description:
Wishlist Blood in the Panopticon on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4109210/Blood_in_the_Panopticon/ 

Blood in the Panopticon is a single-player ASCII action roguelike with analog-horror vibes, where you take care of a damaged Android named C424. Your decisions shape your relationship, as well as the story's outcome. 

Inspired by games like Hades and Hyperlight Drifter, and by stories like Tsutomu Nihei’s BLAME! and Ghost in the Shell, Blood in the Panopticon takes an intimate, narrative-driven approach to progression. It couples this with intense combat, resource management, and several relationship routes.

Blood in the Panopticon releases on the 19th of August 2026.
